title: Mochizuki Honami — On The Music Video Set〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
You all did well during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought we were gonna take it easy today since we just finished playing the festival, but we ended up practicing as hard as we normally do!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we shouldn't let up just because we finished one gig.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we sounded really good during practice today. Do you think it's because we played well during the festival?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think so. Oh, speaking of the festival, we'll be meeting with Mr. Shindo tomorrow to do a debrief.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He wants to discuss it while it's still fresh in our minds, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A debrief, huh?
Do you think he's gonna give us a pat on the back and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I seriously doubt that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I'm kidding♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Still, the festival was so awesome!
All those music lovers gathered in one spot!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I was a little worried at first, with the pressure to put on our best performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, some popular bands went up before us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me. This doesn't have anything to do with how we played, but the t-shirts everyone wore left a big impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was incredible to see a sea of people wearing all kinds of different band t-shirts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you don't really see anything like that at live house events.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Seeing those shirts makes me wish we had our own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As in, official Leo/need t-shirts...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You all feel the same way, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
To be honest, yes.
Seeing someone wearing one of our shirts would make me so happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, for sure! I guarantee it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guarantee it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, as long as we keep at it, I'm sure they'll start making some for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
As long as our fan base keeps growing and we keep doing shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we gotta keep trying in order to get our t-shirts made!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What was the biggest impression the festival left on you, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me? Well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After seeing all those other bands perform, I noticed how they used the large stage very differently from us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How they used the stage?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they made use of all of it very well. For example, they interacted with the audience by moving across the entire length.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's actually pretty common with bands who are used to doing shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish I could do what they can, but I'm not sure if I can yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, some of them mentioned the festival itself while interacting with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For instance, one person got everyone going by shouting, “We're not gonna let the other stages have more fun than us, are we?!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really liked that. They used the festival's atmosphere to solidly connect with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. The audience does usually appreciate it when someone puts in that extra effort for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually, this doesn't just apply to festivals. We could use some of what we've seen in our shows, too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we should try to employ all the good ideas that we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, one more thing comes to mind...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, what's that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just glad that our leader's so organized!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Making full use of a stage, interacting with the audience... It's really astonishing, since I didn't think to look at things so closely.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're all glad that you're our leader, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, I just happened to notice those things...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That means you naturally picked up on those things. All the more reason for us to feel glad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And since you made such good observations, why don't we discuss what we can or can't employ?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. We can also ask what Mr. Shindo thought tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also wanna hear what else you all noticed! And you gotta make sure to tell us more about what you saw, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thank you all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's use tomorrow's debrief to learn how to put on better shows moving forward.
